job.purpose: WHEEL0 stage 2 (the owner's ordered premise test of the rotation lane): 1 minute candles of the settled KXETH15M markets closing 2026-09-12 to before 2026-10-29, from 15 minutes before each batch's first close to 2 minutes before its last.
job.heldout: WHEEL0 has no held-out block (one read, 1 try). Rule (h): no Ethereum market closing on or after 2026-10-29T00:00Z is in the allowlist, and no request ends at or after that instant.
job.notes: Written by the Forensics desk for the Head of R&D's order; owner is MAIN because the runner's owner list has no Forensics entry. Built by build_wheel0_candles.py from the WHEEL0_LISTS answers: every listed market, none dropped by result. 4464 markets, 187 requests. SIZE GUIDE USED: CFRTI_K_CANDLES, the same endpoint, packing and kind of market (24 fifteen minute markets and a 6 hour range a request), measured 37 MB for 215 requests, about 0.17 MB a request; at that rate this file is about 32 MB, far under the 200 MB cap. (MAPBREAK's 1.2 MB a request was for match markets with hours of candles each; a 15 minute market has about 15.)

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
